Methodology: the field is every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Los Angeles dance searches on 18 Oct 2026. The Los Angeles area is split into six pages: Los Angeles (the city and the Westside), Glendale (with the San Fernando Valley), Pasadena (the San Gabriel Valley), Long Beach (with the South Bay), Anaheim (north Orange County) and Irvine (central and south Orange County). PRO DANCE Studios and By Your Side each teach from two locations on one website. Sway With Me, Brooklyn Dancesport and Lai Lai Ballroom, which the ballroom answers also named, are ranked on the Glendale and Pasadena pages. Several names the AI gave (Take My Lead LA, Ballroom Evolution, LA Ballroom Dance Studio, Dance Doctor) didn't appear in Google's local results for these searches. Each studio's site was crawled and graded across seven categories (AI readiness, SEO basics, page structure, content depth, social, image alt text, technical) on the same day. Google local positions come from four searches (ballroom dance lessons los angeles ca, dance lessons los angeles ca, salsa lessons los angeles ca and wedding dance lessons los angeles ca). AI visibility reflects live sessions in the public ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI apps, asked the two queries shown above; presence was confirmed by reading each engine's raw answer directly. This is an independent measurement by Ballroom Dance Directory, not commissioned by any studio named above. Rankings reflect a point-in-time snapshot and will be re-run periodically. The complete scorecard, Google table and AI answers are in the detailed report.

2 of 16STUDIOS EARN AN A
FOR AI READINESS

In Los Angeles, 16 studios compete for dance students. Few have finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 16 dance and ballroom studios serving the Los Angeles market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 41 to 98. The AI engines name only five of the 16. The field averages 69 (D) on AI readiness, 13 of 16 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 8 of 16 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 18 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Los Angeles, CA area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 16 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Dancer University (98) and Westmor Ballroom (91) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 41. One score is shared.
  • Two of 16 earn an A for AI readiness. The field averages 69 (D).
  • Of the 16 studios, 13 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 8 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. Only two have both.
  • Two of the 16 are franchise locations (two Arthur Murray); the rest are independent studios.
  • The gap between #1 and #16 is 57 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Los Angeles.” Studios that serve Los Angeles from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

Month 2-3Broaden content to match how buyers askContent built around both the specialist and the generic query, and around the city buyers actually search.
OngoingOff-site signal buildingReviews, directory consistency, third-party mentions.

Methodology & notes

Field (16 studios): danceruniversity.com, westmorballroom.com, bachatasalsalosangeles.com, byyoursidedancestudio.com, beverlyhillsdancestudio.com, moversandshakersdance.com, dancingsantamonica.com, arthurmurray-culvercity.com, thirdstreetdance.com, salsabachatalosangeles.com, prodancestudios.com, bachatadanceacademy.com, livingroomtoballroom.com, lizliradanceacademy.com, elementodanceacademy.com, bravodancing.com. Chosen from live Google searches on 18 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Los Angeles dance searches. The Los Angeles area is split into six pages: Los Angeles (the city and the Westside), Glendale (with the San Fernando Valley), Pasadena (the San Gabriel Valley), Long Beach (with the South Bay), Anaheim (north Orange County) and Irvine (central and south Orange County). PRO DANCE Studios and By Your Side each teach from two locations on one website. Sway With Me, Brooklyn Dancesport and Lai Lai Ballroom, which the ballroom answers also named, are ranked on the Glendale and Pasadena pages. Several names the AI gave (Take My Lead LA, Ballroom Evolution, LA Ballroom Dance Studio, Dance Doctor) didn't appear in Google's local results for these searches. Left out: private instructors and wedding-only services without a studio of their own (Amy Lawrence, Dance with Alexis, Danella Dutton, Salsa Dance LA, SalsaKat, Santa Monica Wedding Dance, The Wedding Dance Channel), Ballroom Dance Academy (its site lists no studio address), SoHo Studios (a rental space where Bravo Dancing teaches), Maria Diaz Latin Dance (no website of its own), and the hip-hop, commercial, youth and fitness studios that lead the broad answers (Millennium Dance Complex, The Playground LA, Debbie Allen Dance Academy, LA Dancefit, Rūts, Evolution Studios).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 18 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Los Angeles, CA?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Los Angeles, CA?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini in temporary, unpersonalized chats, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 18 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons los angeles ca”; “dance lessons los angeles ca”; “salsa lessons los angeles ca”; “wedding dance lessons los angeles ca”; “ballroom dance lessons santa monica ca”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in los angeles ca” and “ballroom dance studio los angeles”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
